goal: Advance Chu-kei Insight from the completed 10% Plan Detection milestone to at least 25% canonical Plan Detection coverage across the authoritative Japanese listed-company universe. The current baseline is 375 resolved companies out of 3,709 (10.11%); the minimum target at the current universe size is 928 resolved companies. Prioritize company-count breadth over unnecessary deep-detail enrichment while preserving evidence quality. First reconcile repository-generated public data and release-status metadata with the current canonical universe and Plan Detection registry, and verify that the static public product can consume the current frontend manifest/data artifacts without deterministic repository-side blockers. Then expand coverage in bounded, resumable, high-confidence batches by reusing existing primary reviews, verified overrides, audited patches, candidate queues, source-research artifacts, and first-party IR evidence before performing new research. Newly resolved states must remain grounded in official or first-party evidence with preserved provenance; never manufacture coverage by weakening review gates, inferring no_formal_plan from missing evidence, or promoting ambiguous evidence. Keep canonical registry, generated frontend/site datasets, search/browse/detail behavior, release metadata, tests, and quality gates aligned throughout. Treat external hosting/provider configuration that cannot be changed safely from the repository as an explicit boundary rather than silently claiming deployment success. Do not add unrelated product features unless required to remove a deterministic blocker to breadth, public-data synchronization, or safe autonomous continuation.
graduation_criteria: The authoritative Plan Detection registry and public summary represent the current listed-company universe and report at least 25% resolved coverage. At the current 3,709-company universe this requires at least 928 resolved companies; if the authoritative universe size legitimately changes, the threshold must be recalculated as ceil(universe_size * 0.25) and the change documented.

Every newly resolved Plan Detection state is supported by official or first-party evidence with preserved company identity, source URL and document identity, publication or checked date, plan/version/period or fiscal semantics, currentness boundary, and provenance. Missing, ambiguous, stale, or unreviewed evidence is never converted into no_formal_plan or another resolved state merely to increase coverage.

Coverage expansion completes genuine company-level review evidence before rebuilding derived overrides, registry, summaries, and frontend artifacts. Existing formal-plan confirmation, full-text/human-review, candidate non-publication, and no-inference safeguards are preserved or strengthened; regression tests continue to reject false positives and malformed plan-period derivations.

Repository public-product data is synchronized with canonical data: the frontend manifest is generated for the current universe, Plan Detection summary matches the registry, release-status metadata no longer reports materially stale universe/coverage state, bundle/universe identity remains aligned, and repository-side live-site synchronization validation has no deterministic blocker.

Search, browse, filters, and company-detail behavior continue to work over the broad universe after expansion. Relevant local/runtime/static smoke checks and data-integrity checks are green. If external hosting or domain configuration cannot be controlled from the repository, the remaining external action is recorded explicitly with evidence instead of being treated as completed.

All relevant repository validation, Plan Detection regression tests, source/audit checks, quality gates, resumable-pipeline checks, and synchronization checks are green at the final state. The autonomous pipeline remains safely resumable for a successor milestone beyond 25%, with no known deterministic repository-side blocker.
